title: Content Output Increase with AI
takeaway: Introducing AI tools can significantly boost content output for marketing teams.

data.label: Content Output Increase
data.evidence: We’ve seen a 20% increase in content output and a 15% boost in SEO rankings since implementing this training.

data.label: SEO Ranking Boost
data.evidence: We’ve seen a 20% increase in content output and a 15% boost in SEO rankings since implementing this training.

narration: Fused Distribution’s experience shows that integrating AI into a marketing team’s workflow can lead to a substantial increase in content production. Specifically, they observed a 20% rise in content output alongside a 15% improvement in SEO rankings, demonstrating the tangible benefits of a structured AI training program.
